> zcode-computer-use is a single-file, stdlib-only Model Context Protocol (MCP)
> server that gives AI coding agents computer control on macOS: per-window
> screenshots, an indexed accessibility tree with diff markers, element-first
> actions (AXPress) with screenshot-pixel fallback, background observation,
> content-verified text selection, and verified 4-way scroll.

- Install: copy the `mcpServers` JSON from README.md § Install into your MCP client config
- Requirements: macOS, Python 3.9+, cliclick (`brew install cliclick`), Accessibility + Screen Recording grants for the host app; scroll uses Apple's bundled /usr/bin/python3 (pyobjc via Xcode CLT)
- Verify: `python3 tests/test_protocol.py` (headless-safe) · `python3 tests/e2e_textedit.py` (live) · `python3 mcp/server.py selftest`
- Key traps documented: HID-tap wheel events are silently dropped (use kCGSessionEventTap + pixel units); TextEdit ignores scripted AXSelectedTextRange writes (keyboard-walk fallback); CFRelease segfaults in JXA
- License: MIT
